title: EgradxErrorCodes
description: Known values of error.code (see error.json). Every module returns the generic codes for the generic cases, plus its own specific codes; an application's own endpoints should use the generic codes too. Clients must still handle an unknown code.

GenericErrorCode.description: The same code for the same case in every module and every SDK: 401 NOT_AUTHENTICATED, 403 ACCESS_DENIED, 404 NOT_FOUND, 409 CONFLICT, 400 INVALID_REQUEST, 500 INTERNAL_ERROR. A module may answer the same status with a more specific code (e.g. 401 AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS).

AuditErrorCode.description: egradx-audit has no specific codes; it answers with the generic ones.

NotificationErrorCode.description: egradx-notification's specific codes (inbox, preferences and admin controllers).
